 "content": "from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    line = next(v for v, _ in counts.most_common() if v != background)

    # Grid lines are the complete rows and columns that contain no background.
    # Intersections whose color differs from the line color encode the vertices.
    marked_rows = [r for r in range(h)
                   if all(grid[r][c] != background for c in range(w))
                   and any(grid[r][c] != line for c in range(w))]
    marked_cols = [c for c in range(w)
                   if all(grid[r][c] != background for r in range(h))
                   and any(grid[r][c] != line for r in range(h))]

    out = []
    for r1, r2 in zip(marked_rows, marked_rows[1:]):
        row = []
        for c1, c2 in zip(marked_cols, marked_cols[1:]):
            corners = (grid[r1][c1], grid[r1][c2], grid[r2][c1], grid[r2][c2])
            row.append(corners[0] if all(v == corners[0] for v in corners) else background)
        out.append(row)
    return out
"
}
